fields.questionText: Which of the following is equal to the expression shown in the given figure?
solutionSteps: (cot θ · sec² θ)/cosec θ = (cos θ/sin θ) × (1/cos² θ) × sin θ = 1/cos θ = sec θ. So option (a) sec θ.

fields.questionText: The rod AC of a TV disc antenna is fixed at right angles to the wall AB, and a rod CD supports the disc, as shown in the given figure. AC = 1.5 m and CD = 3 m. If θ = ∠ADC, compute the value of sec θ + cosec θ.
solutionSteps: [1 mark] In right ΔCAD (right angle at A), AD = √(CD² − AC²) = √(9 − 2.25) = (3√3)/2 m. So sec θ = CD/AD = 3 ÷ (3√3/2) = 2/√3 and cosec θ = CD/AC = 3/1.5 = 2.
